issue.title: Add a Directive glossary strand for % directive invocations
issue.description: Add a Directive glossary strand naming one `%name` use of a prompt directive in prompt text (with its arguments and modifiers), parallel to the Macro Invocation (smack) strand. `%` is the only prompt sigil whose instance lacks a strand: `#` maps to Macro Invocation, `@` maps to Artifact Reference, `+` maps to Project Tag. Research for the smack plan deliberately left this out of scope. Follow the strand conventions: keyword plus aliases, no `type:` key, body free of terminology-guard tripwords, then `sase memory init --no-commit`, roster allowlist update in tests/_macro_terminology_docs.py if the roster rewraps, and matcher-probe verification.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add sase/memory/glossary/directive.md naming one %name directive use, regenerate roster/shims, update guard allowlist.

issue.creation_reason: Approved smack-glossary plan defers the % sigil strand; it is the only prompt sigil whose use site still lacks a glossary term.
